classification_contract.local_or_non_catalog: CTE names, table variables, temporary tables, trigger pseudo-tables and comment/string tokens are manifest-covered exclusions; never catalog edges.
classification_contract.resolved_edge: Only a catalog reference resolved to an exact qualified verified object ID can emit RESOLVED_EDGE.
classification_contract.unresolved: A syntactically valid catalog reference with zero verified matches retains its synthetic/source span, reason and L03/B2 owner; no guessed target, executable binding or closure pass.
classification_contract.evidence_boundary: Inline fixture inputs and catalogs are explicitly synthetic test design, not extracted authoritative source sites. Parser/product/runtime execution remains NOT_RUN.
